description: Theme taxonomy for organizing AdaResearch artifacts by purpose and function. Used for developer workflow organization.

primitives.name: Primitives & Building Blocks
primitives.description: Basic shapes, grab objects, foundational elements for building experiences

audio.name: Audio & Harmony
audio.description: Music sequencers, synthesis, spectral analysis, sound generation

physics.name: Physics & Dynamics
physics.description: Soft bodies, rigid body simulations, oscillators, physical puzzles

procedural.name: Procedural Generation
procedural.description: Noise systems, terrain generation, growth algorithms, procedural content

emergence.name: Emergence & Complexity
emergence.description: Cellular automata, self-organization, evolutionary algorithms, edge of chaos

qfep.name: QFEP Visualization & Control
qfep.description: Queer Free Energy Principle interactive tools - lambda, phi, entropy, free energy

waves.name: Waves & Oscillation
waves.description: Sine/cosine visualizations, Fourier transforms, standing waves, harmonic motion

philosophy.name: Narrative & Philosophy
philosophy.description: Foundations crisis artifacts, art-mathematics connections, conceptual pieces

puzzles.name: Interactive Puzzles
puzzles.description: Assembly challenges, construction puzzles, relief compositions

tools.name: Navigation & Tools
tools.description: UI elements, navigation aids, system utilities, catalogs

advanced.description: Complex systems with multiple interacting components

expert.description: Highly sophisticated artifacts requiring deep theoretical understanding

tagging_guidelines.dev_themes: Array of 1-3 theme keys that best describe the artifact's purpose
tagging_guidelines.complexity: One of: beginner, intermediate, advanced, expert

notes: Artifacts may belong to multiple themes (use dev_themes array)
Theme metadata is additive - does not affect existing artifact loading
lookup_name must remain stable for backward compatibility
Update artifact_theme_index.json when adding theme metadata to artifacts
